question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Deleterious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Harmless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deleterious"** means causing harm or damage. It is often used to describe something that is harmful to health or well-being. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking has a deleterious effect on your lungs.
 
 
• The correct antonym of deleterious is **"Harmless"**, which means not causing any harm or injury. (अहानिकर)
 
 
• **Example:** The medicine is completely harmless and safe for children.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'deleterious'** is **'harmless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Harmless**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dangerous **(खतरनाक): Likely to cause harm or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** Driving at high speeds on wet roads is very dangerous.
 
 

 
• **Toxic **(विषाक्त): Poisonous or harmful, especially to health.
 
 
• **Example:** The factory released toxic gases into the environment.
 
 

 
• **Poisonous** (विषैला): Containing poison or being very harmful.
 
 
• **Example:** Some mushrooms are poisonous and should not be eaten.
